_comment: Standalone styling + symbology for the calculator's maps — the interactive TAZ map (MapView) and the printable report's project-area map (reportMap). Edit values here; no code changes needed. Colors are either CSS strings (e.g. 'rgb(107,57,0)') or [r, g, b, a] arrays where a is 0..1.

initialView._comment: Starting camera for the interactive map: [longitude, latitude] center and zoom level (Denver metro, statewide-ish overview).

tazBoundary._comment: Visible TAZ boundaries are painted by the published vector tile layer, restyled to a dotted brown line. lineWidthZoomStops is a list of [zoom, widthPx] pairs interpolated linearly (≈0px zoomed out → 3.2px zoomed in, fading out at low zoom).

selection._comment: Highlight overlay for selected TAZs — used by both the interactive map overlay and the report map. CDOT blue, semi-transparent fill with a dark-blue outline.

sketch._comment: Polygon-draw preview shown while the user is drawing a selection area on the interactive map.
